notes: The only place akuko keeps model ids and prices (plan R-2). Every model carries a last_verified date; `doctor` flags entries older than stale_after_days. billing: free = costs akuko nothing; direct-api = akuko calls a paid HTTP API with the user's key (never on host A in v0.x); connected-mcp = a paid generation tool on a connected MCP server (needs the confirmation line on host A). Entries with example: true are placeholders for tests and for WP-06 to replace: their prices are illustrative, not quotes, and the gate refuses them outside tests.

manual-handoff.source: No cost to akuko: you paste the prompt package into a tool of your choice. Any spend you report when handing the file back is recorded in the ledger.

fal-video.label: fal video (Kling image-to-video on fal) — your fal key

fal-ai/kling-video/v2.5-turbo/pro/image-.source: https://fal.ai/pricing lists this endpoint at $0.07 per second; https://fal.ai/models/fal-ai/kling-video/v2.5-turbo/pro/image-to-video says $0.35 for a 5 s video and $0.07 per additional second. Input/output schema: https://fal.ai/models/fal-ai/kling-video/v2.5-turbo/pro/image-to-video/api (image_url, duration enum 5 or 10, video.url output; no audio field, so it is silent). Read 2026-11-09.

fal-ai/kling-video/v2.6/pro/image-to-vid.source: https://fal.ai/models/fal-ai/kling-video/v2.6/pro/image-to-video: 'Videos generated without audio cost $0.07 per second' (also on https://fal.ai/pricing). akuko always sends generate_audio false, so this is the audio-off price. Schema: https://fal.ai/models/fal-ai/kling-video/v2.6/pro/image-to-video/api (start_image_url, duration enum 5 or 10, generate_audio default true, video.url output). Read 2026-11-09.

Same endpoint as the entry without '#audio' (akuko strips the suffix and sends generate_audio true). https://fal.ai/models/fal-ai/kling-video/v2.6/pro/image-to-video: 'Videos with native audio cost $0.14 per second' (voice control, $0.168, is not offered). Read 2026-11-09.

gemini-image.label: Gemini image (Nano Banana) — your Gemini API key

gemini-nano-banana-2.1.source: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing (served from https://aistudio.google.com/docs/pricing), Standard tier, 1K output, read 2026-11-07. Image output only: reference images are also billed as input tokens. Reference limits: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/image-generation (read 2026-11-07). Up to 14 reference images (10 object + 4 character).

gemini-3.1-flash-image.source: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing (served from https://aistudio.google.com/docs/pricing), Standard tier, 1K output, read 2026-11-07. Image output only: reference images are also billed as input tokens. Reference limits: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/image-generation (read 2026-11-07). Up to 14 reference images (10 object + 4 character).

gemini-3-pro-image.source: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing (served from https://aistudio.google.com/docs/pricing), Standard tier, 1K output, read 2026-11-07. Image output only: reference images are also billed as input tokens. Reference limits: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/image-generation (read 2026-11-07). Up to 14 reference images (6 object + 5 character + 3 style).

fal.label: fal image (Nano Banana 2 on fal) — your fal key

fal-ai/nano-banana-2.source: https://fal.ai/pricing lists fal-ai/nano-banana-2 and fal-ai/nano-banana-2/edit (used when a unit has references) at $0.08 per image; the model pages carry no price. Input/limits: https://fal.ai/models/fal-ai/nano-banana-2/edit/api (14-reference total, resolution 0.5K-4K; akuko requests the 1K default), read 2026-11-07. Queue API: https://fal.ai/docs/model-apis/model-endpoints/queue. fal does not say whether 2K/4K cost more; akuko does not request them.

elevenlabs.label: ElevenLabs text to speech (voice-over with word timings) — your ElevenLabs key

eleven_flash_v2_5.source: https://elevenlabs.io/pricing/api, Text to Speech, row "Flash / Turbo": $0.04 per 1K characters, read 2026-11-09. Model id and the 40,000-character request limit: https://elevenlabs.io/docs/overview/models (read 2026-11-09). Endpoint and timing response (alignment.characters / character_start_times_seconds / character_end_times_seconds): https://elevenlabs.io/docs/api-reference/text-to-speech/convert-with-timestamps (read 2026-11-09). Auth header xi-api-key: https://elevenlabs.io/docs/api-reference/authentication.

eleven_multilingual_v2.source: https://elevenlabs.io/pricing/api, Text to Speech, row "v2 Multilingual": $0.08 per 1K characters, read 2026-11-09. Model id and the 10,000-character request limit: https://elevenlabs.io/docs/overview/models (read 2026-11-09). Same with-timestamps endpoint as above.
